name: makio64
description: Plugins by Makio64 (David Ronai). The Office: a fun pixel-art view of what your coding agents are doing, per project and across accounts: Clawd for Claude, and characters of their own for Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Kimi and Grok.

plugins.name: theoffice
plugins.description: A live dashboard of your coding agents, drawn as a pixel-art office. Spot the agent waiting on you, see which projects got the hours, and replay your day, week or month as a timelapse, across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor and every account. Type /theoffice.
